plan: Given my private value of $6, I aim to maximize profit by winning the auction without overpaying. Since values are random each round and there's no history to learn from, I'll bid slightly above my value to increase winning chances while minimizing potential loss. A bid of $6.5 ensures I can win if others bid below their value. If I win, I pay the second-highest bid, ideally less than $6.5, ensuring profit.

Given my value of $40, I should aim to bid slightly above my value to ensure a win if competitors bid close to their top value. Since this is the only round, maximizing profit means winning the item without overpaying. I will bid $40.1 to secure the item if others bid near their maximum, minimizing potential loss while ensuring a win. This strategy balances the risk of bidding too high against the chance of losing.

My value for the item is $28. To maximize my profit, I should bid slightly above the midpoint of my value and the maximum possible value ($49) to increase the chance of winning while minimizing potential overpayment. A bid around $35 should be competitive without risking a loss beyond my value.
